_doc: Security doctrines (Security.doctrine): how a faction guards a site and answers trouble. A faction names its doctrine in factions.json; anything a doctrine leaves out comes from 'default'. All numbers are HOUSE-RULE (the Night City 2045 book has no per-faction guard detail). budget: the guard roster is crew_size x (base + per_level x security) edgerunners' worth (CPR p399 costs: Mook 1, Lieutenant 2, Mini Boss 3), with officers by security level and at least min_mooks Mooks. outer_patrols: pairs of Mooks out in the open, one pair per area_per_pair squares over area_start, at most max_pairs. A Security Code's intensity reaches this budget through the security level only (Campaign.location_levels, NC2045 p.7). alarm: radio_range rouses the caller's side within that many squares, shout_range spreads an alert on a floor. Who responds to the call, and when, comes from the gig's Security Codes (SecurityCode), not the doctrine. trauma_cards: the mark holds one (mark), officers (Lieutenants and Mini Bosses) at this chance. keycards: guards carry their zone's keycard.
